en.headline: Observatory expects temperatures to fall to 18 degrees next week
en.dek: A cold front is forecast to cross the south China coast on Monday, bringing stronger northerly winds and appreciably cooler mornings from Tuesday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said on Friday that a cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China early on Monday, followed by an intense northeast monsoon.

Urban temperatures are forecast to range between 18 and 24 degrees on Tuesday, appreciably cooler in the morning, and between 19 and 26 degrees on Wednesday. It will be cooler still in the New Territories.
The Observatory said the weather would become generally fine and dry midweek, with a large day-night temperature difference over inland areas. Upper-air disturbances may bring rain later next week.
Over the weekend a strong northeast monsoon will continue to affect the Guangdong coast, with winds of force 5 to 6 and occasional rain patches.

zh.headline: 天文台料下周氣溫顯著下降 市區最低或見18度
zh.dek: 一道冷鋒預料周一初時橫過華南沿岸，轉吹偏北強風，周二起早上明顯較涼。
body: 香港天文台周五表示，預料一道冷鋒會在周一初時橫過華南沿岸，其後受強烈東北季候風影響，北風增強，氣溫顯著下降。
預測周二市區氣溫介乎18至24度，早上顯著較涼；周三介乎19至26度。新界地區會再低兩三度。
天文台指，下周中期廣東普遍晴朗及乾燥，內陸地區早上清涼，日夜溫差較大。高空擾動料於下周後期為華南帶來降雨。
周末期間，一股達強風程度的東北季候風繼續影響廣東沿岸，本港風勢頗大，早晚有一兩陣雨。
